reference.operation: Watermark consumes raw global colorFill/fontSizeLG/zIndexPopupBase, independently of CSS declarations, cssVar prefix and components.Watermark. Calls are traced while native Canvas fillText still draws; actual repeated PNG dimensions, peak alpha and layer CSS are measured. Includes explicit/per-line/undefined font priorities and nested/reset/sibling scopes. Readback uses a separate PNG canvas, not production drawing contexts.
